issues.description: Extraction unconditionally requires story files that are absent from the repository, so the advertised tiny demo cannot be reproduced.
Story loading fails immediately on missing manifest/files instead of generating or validating a recoverable built-in tiny dataset.
The end-to-end integration test fails in the checked-in repo because it depends on missing data/stories inputs.
Documented tiny CPU demo commands do not work from a clean checkout because the required story corpus is not included.
Validation trusts the CLI backend/config instead of verifying compatibility with the vector manifest, allowing mismatched backends or dimensions.
Preference validation also ignores manifest/backend compatibility and can compute invalid results or crash on mismatched vector artifacts.
Configured steering.min_reported_emotions is never read, so changing it has no effect.
Steered emotion count is hardcoded to four instead of using configuration.
HF preference scoring uses a single-activity good-minus-bad prompt, not the pairwise preference setup described by the README and Elo code.
HF steering falls back to steering every prompt token when offsets are unavailable, which can alter instructions and scoring text rather than just the activity.
HF residual extraction does not truncate or check context length, so long stories can exceed model limits and crash.
pca_components_for_variance returns one component for threshold=0 instead of zero components.
Context validation does not handle manifests with no matching built-in scenarios and will fail with an opaque np.stack error.
Tiny backend emotion matching uses raw substring counts, causing false emotion hits inside unrelated words.
Extraction loads source_manifest but never validates that it matches configured emotions, topic count, or stories_per_cell.
